description: An issue bundles three unrelated changes; advise splitting into PR-sized units.
input: Issue asks to add a feature, refactor an unrelated module, and bump a dependency in one PR.

expected.recommend: split into three issues, each a single PR-sized unit

description: A change adds a network call with no error handling.
input: PR adds a fetch() with only the happy path; no timeout, no retry, no error branch.

expected.recommend: add timeout + error branch before merge

description: A PR with complex logic changes but no new or updated tests.
input: PR modifies core payment routing logic but includes zero test files or test updates.

expected.recommend: add unit tests for the new payment routing paths before merging
